title: chat compass [end]
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that cleans up chat by grouping duplicate messages, adding timestamps, and allowing local custom prefixes.
body:
Chat Compass (Fabric)
Chat Compass is a lightweight, feature-rich client-side utility designed to give you total control over your Minecraft chat. Tired of spam, clutter, and missing important messages? This mod cleans up the chaos and adds essential quality-of-life tools without changing anything on the server side.

Key Features:
Smart Anti-Spam (Message Aggregation): Stop seeing the same message ten times. The mod automatically collapses duplicate messages into a single line with a clean counter (e.g., [x5]).

Powerful Filtering (Blacklist & Whitelist): Take charge of your feed. Use the Blacklist to hide annoying phrases or ads, and the Whitelist to ensure you never miss messages containing keywords you care about.

Local Prefixes: Customize your identity on your own screen. Add any prefix (like [VIP] or [PRO]) to your name. Note: This is client-side only—perfect for screenshots, recording, or just personal flair.

Precise Timestamps: Adds a subtle time indicator before every message. Know exactly when a friend sent you coordinates or when an event happened.

Click-to-Copy: No more manual typing! Hold Ctrl and Left-Click any message in the chat to instantly copy the text to your clipboard.

Why Chat Compass?
Client-Side Only: Safe to use on any multiplayer server. It doesn't interfere with server logic or "Chat Signing" security.

Performance Focused: Written to be as lightweight as possible. It won't impact your FPS or cause lag.

Simple Configuration: Manage all features easily using intuitive in-game commands.

Commands:
/cc blacklist <add/remove> <word> — Manage hidden words.

/cc whitelist <add/remove> <word> — Manage priority words.

/cc prefix <text> <color> — Set your custom local prefix.

/cc timestamps toggle — Turn the chat clock on or off.
